title: 第3章 混沌亿万里降临下界第4章 这天塌了呀无尽怒火
slug: 被问罪当天无上帝族杀来
content_zh:
绝对火种点燃！
混沌序列本源释放中！
破败身体修复中！
修为恢复中！
……
一个个字条出现在陈稳的眼前。
轰！
于一瞬间，天地震动不止，那本源之气如同火花般于半空中炸开。
只见无尽的天穹深处荡开，亿万混沌之气荡尽飞速往外荡开。
同时间，那一尊尊混沌异象从中探出，引动惊天波澜来，人人为之窒息不已。
而陈稳的修为也在一点点地恢复，古老的气息从他体内散发，一圈圈荡着序列印记。
乍一看，无不让人为之动容，无不为之骇然。
“这……怎么可能！”
楚幼微震恐地看着眼前的惊天异象。
罗浩也脸色狂变，不敢相信眼前发生的一切。
陈稳的情况，他们再清楚不过了。
一是修为已经被废了，二是神体本源被掏干净了。
现在的陈稳，说白了就是空有身体的废物而已。
一旦得不到及时的治疗，不说恢复了，就是活过来也是一种问题。
可现在呢，陈稳不仅渐渐恢复过来了，连本就被掏尽的本源也复苏了。

“哈哈哈，果不愧是传说中的荒古杀生体。”
就在这时，一阵洪亮的声音突然响起。
众人尽皆寻声看过去。
入眼的是一位浑身缠绕着生死之力的老者从半空中徐徐降落。
显然，眼前的老者是一位生死境的强者。
这个世界的修炼境界分为十三大境。
灵窍境，铸体境，两极境，阴阳境，天人境，生死境，涅槃境。
天王境，尊皇境，圣上境，至尊境，证道境【准帝境】和大帝境。
每一大境还分十重。
罗浩一见到老者，立时迎了上去，躬身道，“弟子，见过师父。”
秦牧贪婪的目光从陈稳身上收回，看着罗浩道，“此子，就是你所说的杀死我宫弟子的罪人？”
“是的，这为弟子亲眼所见，特让师父前来主持公道。”罗浩连声道。
“那他的身份可调查清楚了？”秦牧悠悠道。
“一清二楚，就是一个没有任何背景的孤儿。”罗浩连忙道。
content_en:
Absolutely ignited!
The origin of Chaos Sequence is being released!
The broken body is being repaired!
Cultivation is recovering!
…
One note after another appeared in front of Chen Wen's eyes.
boom!
In an instant, the heaven and earth shook, and the original energy exploded in mid-air like sparks.
I saw the endless depths of the sky swinging open, and billions of chaotic energy quickly swinging outwards.
At the same time, the chaotic vision of the statue emerged from it, causing shocking waves, and everyone was suffocated by it.
And Chen Wen's cultivation level is also recovering bit by bit, and the ancient aura emanates from his body, with sequence marks swaying in circles.
At first glance, everyone is moved and shocked.
"This...how is it possible!"
Chu Youwei looked at the shocking vision in front of him in horror.
Luo Hao's face also changed wildly, and he couldn't believe what was happening in front of him.
They knew Chen Wen's situation very well.
One is that the cultivation level has been abolished, and the other is that the origin of the divine body has been removed.
Chen Wen now is, to put it bluntly, nothing more than a waste of an empty body.
Once treatment is not received in time, not only recovery, but survival is also a problem.
But now, Chen Wen not only gradually recovered, but also recovered his roots that had been drained away.
"Hahaha, it is indeed the legendary ancient killer."
At this moment, a loud voice suddenly sounded.
Everyone looked over in search of the sound.
What caught his eye was an old man wrapped in the power of life and death slowly descending from mid-air.
Obviously, the old man in front of him is a strong man in the life and death realm.
The realm of cultivation in this world is divided into thirteen realms.
The spiritual orifice realm, the cast body realm, the two-pole realm, the yin and yang realm, the realm of heaven and man, the realm of life and death, and the realm of nirvana.
Heavenly King Realm, Sovereign Emperor Realm, Holy Supreme Realm, Supreme Realm, Enlightenment Realm [Quasi-Emperor Realm] and Great Emperor Realm.
Each realm is divided into ten levels.
As soon as Luo Hao saw the old man, he immediately greeted him, bowed and said, "Disciple, I have met the master."
Qin Mu withdrew his greedy eyes from Chen Wen, looked at Luo Hao and said, "Is this son the sinner you said killed the disciples of my palace?"
"Yes, this disciple has seen this with his own eyes, and has specially asked Master to come and seek justice." Luo Hao said repeatedly.
"Then his identity has been clearly investigated?" Qin Mu said leisurely.
"It's clear that he is an orphan with no background." Luo Hao said quickly.
